user_story: As a registered user, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.

positive.title: Registered user logs in with valid credentials
steps: Enter a valid email in the email field.
Enter the correct password in the password field.
positive.expected_result: The user is successfully logged into their account and is redirected to the account dashboard.

negative.title: Registered user attempts to log in with an incorrect password
steps: Enter a valid email in the email field.
Enter an incorrect password in the password field.
negative.expected_result: The user receives an error message indicating that the email or password is incorrect and remains on the login page.

edge.title: Registered user logs in with a password at maximum character limit
steps: Enter a valid email in the email field.
Enter a valid password at the maximum allowed character limit in the password field.
edge.expected_result: The user is successfully logged into their account and is redirected to the account dashboard, confirming that the maximum character password was handled correctly.
